episodes.name: Never Meet Your Heroes
episodes.overviewEn: Archer Kate Bishop lands in the middle of a criminal conspiracy, forcing Hawkeye out of retirement.
episodes.overviewAr: تهبط آرتشر كيت بيشوب وسط مؤامرة إجرامية ، مما يجبر هوك على الخروج من التقاعد.

episodes.name: Hide and Seek
episodes.overviewEn: Clint has to help Kate disentangle herself from the Tracksuit mafia and a real-life murder mystery.
episodes.overviewAr: يتعين على كلينت مساعدة كيت في فصل نفسها عن مافيا بدلة رياضية ولغز جريمة قتل واقعي.

episodes.name: Echoes
episodes.overviewEn: After narrowly escaping the Tracksuits and their daunting leader Maya Lopez, Clint and Kate work together to find answers. With each step they take, however, they find themselves sliding deeper into a rapidly growing criminal conspiracy.
episodes.overviewAr: بعد الهروب بصعوبة من الملابس الرياضية وقائدهم المخيف مايا لوبيز ، يعمل "كلينت" و "كيت" معًا للعثور على إجابات.  ومع كل خطوة يتخذونها ، فإنهم يجدون أنفسهم ينزلقون بشكل أعمق إلى مؤامرة إجرامية سريعة النمو.

episodes.name: Partners, Am I Right?
episodes.overviewEn: Secrets are revealed and hard truths emerge, culminating in a battle against two opposing forces.

episodes.name: Ronin
episodes.overviewEn: After a fallout between Clint and Kate, the younger archer is ready to abandon her dream of becoming a hero. Meanwhile, a guilt-ridden Clint prepares to go face-to-face with the Tracksuit mafia, owning up to past actions. Everything changes, however, when Kate makes a surprising discovery.

episodes.name: So This Is Christmas?
episodes.overviewEn: Clint and Kate’s partnership is tested as they face the consequences of exposing the conspiracy.
